name: calcwise
description: CalcWise – Financial Calculators: SIP, FD interest and more, with animated charts.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets/js src tests/js webpack.config.js --ignore-pattern "src/vendor/**"
scripts.format: wp-scripts format assets src tests/js webpack.config.js
scripts.test:integration:multisite: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") env WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -- -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist
